name: Mythic Blinding Critical (Critical, Mythic)
source: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats
book: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

facets.bk: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

body:
You can blind foes with a weapon blow at will.

Prerequisites: Blinding Critical, Critical Focus, base attack bonus +15, 3rd mythic tier.

Benefit(s): Once per round when you hit a foe with an attack, but the attack is not a critical, you may expend two uses of Mythic Power to inflict the effect of the Blinding Critical feat rather than your attack’s normal damage.

You may not add the effects of more than one mythic critical feat to a single attack.
